## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the final user-visible behavior. Link the related issue, if any. English or Korean is welcome.

## Verification

List the commands actually run, their results, and the source revision or snapshot tested. Distinguish generated fixtures, real media, native UI and manual review. Explain any failed, interrupted or unrun checks.

## Compatibility and data

Describe effects on existing documents, original media, backup/recovery, Undo/Redo, cancellation and export. If none apply, say why briefly.

## Review notes

List material limitations, migration steps, and new dependencies or media with their provenance and applicable license. Do not attach private videos, transcripts, credentials or an unsanitized `Artifacts` directory.
